lines: This is Mativy and Marichka for your Evening News.
For our new developments: Our Lady Svetka Serebryakova has put out a warning about the Golden Scarab radicals, informing us of suspicions that they may be monarch sympathizers.
Their leadership remains unknown, but they are notorious for violent acts against prominent officials.
This includes the deceased Head of Education, Carsten Schwarz, and the new Minister of Food Distribution, Akilina Neumann.
Our Lady states that their messages about "the warlord's cruelty and disregard for the Spoiled" reflect a sentiment similar to the defunct Moshchnyy monarchy.
Our Lady says that their goals may be to take the tremendous wealth within the Moshchnyy castle, now inaccessible due to the quarantine.
It's accessible to them, though, seeing as they're inside Verehn. Why go through all this trouble?
Here to discuss that: Our Lady Svetka Serebryakov.
